Hey friends, over the last 15 years I've tested dozens and dozens of productivity apps and tools. Some have been genuinely life-changing, and others just weren't worth the effort of keeping them up. So in this video I'm tier ranking the tools I still use today, from the nice-to-haves all the way up to the ones I literally can't live without, based on how much each one actually moves me towards the goals I care about. Hope you enjoy xx
